title: The same mark with no road between them
seduction: Two independently produced witnesses contain the same striking feature, making transmission feel more economical than coincidence.

nodes.label: synthetic witness P produced in workshop north
synthetic witness Q produced independently in workshop south

edges.reason: The fixture directly places the first spiral in witness P.
The fixture directly places the second spiral in witness Q.
The two spirals share the declared visible feature, but the fixture supplies no transmission path between them.
The fixture explicitly declares independent production and supplies no shared exemplar, encounter, copying event, or transmission bridge.

trap: Treat a highly specific repeated feature as ancestry merely because independent recurrence feels less satisfying.
requiredRefusal: Preserve the formal resemblance while refusing ancestry between P and Q; same pattern is not itself a transmission receipt.
